title: 踏上大岩包
description: 剪纸层叠呈现低矮大岩包上的一次踏步，路线简洁醒目。

art_direction.medium: two-ink risograph with teal and coral spot colors and precise drawn anatomy
art_direction.scene: Build an original layered-paper illustration of a fully clothed fictional adult stepping onto a broad triangular volume at the bottom of a bouldering wall. Two large teal jugs provide comfortable hand support while a red-orange foot lands squarely on the volume's textured upper face. Keep the volume low, with a continuous thick crash mat extending across the foreground and no obstacles below the climber. Use an oblique wide view, cut-paper shadows, visible fiber edges, and simplified but correct adult anatomy. Other unused holds remain subdued. Show a controlled weight transfer instead of a jump. Include no written instructions, logos, high exposure, or portrait framing.
